subject: Pre-demo load snapshot + scheduling dedicated sizing call
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Michael Chen <michael.chen@finora.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Pre-demo load snapshot + scheduling dedicated sizing call

Hi Michael —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the sizing session and the technical deep-dive: 

Summary notes
- Primary workload: near-real-time risk scoring for 150 TPS peak, burst to 400 TPS for 30s every 5 minutes
- Typical prompt length: ~350 tokens; 32k context not required for initial pilot
- Latency target: p95 ~ 120ms for single-request scoring path, lower for batch/async backfill

Next steps
1) Dedicated capacity sizing call (60–75m) to validate throughput assumptions and confirm GPU pool sizing — goal: pick a slot this week
2) Technical deep-dive (30–45m) with SE + infra to go over payloads, auth, and KV cache behavior
3) Pre-call artifacts: a small load snapshot (I attached load_snapshot.csv) and our MVP requirements doc (MVP_requirements.docx) — could you confirm these reflect current traffic?

Proposed times (PT):
- Wed 8/6 10:00–11:15 or 14:00–15:15
- Thu 8/7 09:30–10:45 or 16:00–17:15

If those don't work, happy to send a Calendly link. Also looping Karthik (SE) and Marcus (AE) who will join the sizing call.

Thanks — can you confirm a preferred slot and whether we should include any additional Finora engineers on the call?

Best,
Kimberly Park
Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: load_snapshot.csv (csv), MVP_requirements.docx (docx)

From: Michael Chen <michael.chen@finora.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Finora Engineering Team <eng@finora.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 17:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pre-demo load snapshot + scheduling dedicated sizing call

Kimberly —

Appreciate the clear recap. Confirming the snapshot looks representative; I pulled it into our staging metrics and the burst windows line up. We should include our platform engineer, Jenna Ortiz (jenna.ortiz@finora.com), on the call — she'll drive the sampling and auth setup.

Of your proposed times PT, Thu 8/7 09:30–10:45 works best for us. If possible, could we shrink the dedicated sizing to 60 minutes and then do the 30–45m deep-dive immediately after (same day) to respect some of our folks' calendars?

Also, one quick ask: can you share any example payload sizes you'd like us to provide? We're collecting a small set of typical requests but want to make sure we include the right variants.

Thanks — Michael
Michael Chen
Head of Platform | Finora Financial
michael.chen@finora.com

Perfect — thanks Michael, Thu 8/7 09:30 PT is tentatively booked on our side. We'll aim for a 60m dedicated sizing call followed by a 30m technical deep-dive as you suggested (total 90m).

A couple of quick items to make the call efficient:
- Payload examples: sample JSONs with happy-path, truncated contexts, and a few large instruction-heavy prompts (we typically care about request size in bytes and tokenized length). If you can provide 3–5 examples that cover short/medium/long payloads that will be ideal.
- Pre-call questionnaire: please fill the short intake doc (link below) — it helps Karthik size the GPU mix and caching strategy.
- Calendar: if Jenna or anyone else needs a separate invite, reply-all with their address and we'll add them.

Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/dedicated-sizing-slot
Pre-call questionnaire: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-pre-demo-questionnaire

We'll attach the finalized invite once you confirm Jenna. Marcus will run the demo portion and I will own the sizing session.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Aug 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pre-demo load snapshot + scheduling dedicated sizing call

Thanks all — quick technical note ahead of the call.

Couple of items I'd like Finora to provide before Thu's session so we can size accurately:
- Representative payloads (3–5) as Kimberly noted; include raw byte size and tokenized length if possible
- Typical concurrency distribution (e.g., 150 steady TPS with bursts to 400 for 30s every 5m) — if you have a 24h histogram that helps
- Any constraints around data retention / KV cache TTLs (we'll need this to estimate memory footprint)

I'd also like to run a short pre-call micro-benchmark: a 5-minute synthetic replay at 50% of your reported peak (i.e., ~200 TPS) to validate our latency assumptions. If Finora can open a staging endpoint we can point a small client at it and capture p50/p95/p99 for the scoring path. This is optional but will make the sizing call much more actionable.

Attachment: latency_targets.png — shows the p95 target bands we typically aim for by workload class.

I'll join the session as SE; Marcus will lead the demo. Looking forward to it.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
